tradeoff.ratio_note: The ratio between the two figures is 12-18x by construction (10% share x 12 months x 10-15 years); published visitors set only the scale.

sources.spend: DOSM Domestic Tourism Survey 2024: RM106.7bn / 260.1m domestic visitors = RM410 per visitor, applied to all visitors, so spending is a floor.
sources.reef_adjacent: Reef-adjacent share: 10% of tourism spending (Spalding et al. 2017), a foreign method coefficient applied to Malaysian inputs only.
sources.visitors: Visitors: Department of Marine Park state series, 2013-2017 average (data.gov.my); Sabah Parks public visitor statistics, 2024.
sources.recovery: Reef recovery needs at least 10-15 years without new disturbance (James Cook University, 2019).
